newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline firmer, propped up by hedging.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline firmer, propped up by hedging.

text.p: NWE gasoline prices were generally firmer on Thursday supported by hedging activity against swaps, but outright trade was thin with little sign of movement of cargoes transatlantic.
Traders said demand remained limited to swaps related trade house buying for barges which was propping up an otherwise well stocked market. Winter eurograde traded a $210 and regular at $200 fob ARA.
"The trade houses continue to take in the higher priced barges and collect money on the swaps, they may even move a cargo later on," one traders said.
